narrative.overview: A pharmaceutical graphic program applied to clinical notes: white paper, one grotesk on a strict grid, and colour that always codes something. Each workspace is a product line with its own field colour; verification is a second fixed code carried as a stripe on every sentence, session row and history strip.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces, one shadow for floating layers

rules.name: The Code Rule
rules.body: Verification colours mean only verification; risk uses negative/warning.

rules.name: The Action Rule
rules.body: The line colour on a filled control means an available action.

rules.name: The Line Rule
rules.body: One product line per screen, except the workspace picker.

dos: Do give every sentence, session row and history strip its stripe.
Do set numbers in tabular figures.
Do keep the recording screen to one quiet field.
donts: Don't use glass, blur or gradients.
Don't reuse code colours for decoration.
Don't add eyebrow labels above headings.
